scguns.desc.whistler: A well constructed single shot rifle, chambered in a powerful advanced round. A favorite among Rust Ridge's elite hunters.
scguns.desc.m22_waltz: Standard COG sidearm after the Federal split. Designed for exosuit integration. Without mechanical arm support, its recoil is punishing.
scguns.desc.scratches: Shoulder mounted steam powered array firing steel needles. R&D engineering applied compressed air to close quarters devastation. An Industrial prototype.
scguns.desc.rg_jigsaw: Firing advanced rounds, this bullpup DMR was primarily used in ambush tactics.
scguns.desc.mas_peddler: Mas 55 conversion fitted with a Peddler Unit, chambered in a smaller caliber.
scguns.desc.homemaker: Lever Action Conversion of the Killer 23. Chambered in advanced rounds with a fitted splitter barrel for increased pellet count.
scguns.desc.trotters: Long barrel bolt action rifle firing heavy shells with handling not seen in most Piglin design.
scguns.desc.nervepinch: Railgun firing shattering blaze fuel charges before conscious thought completes. Each impact erupts in flames that burn through steel and soul alike.
